The Cult of Mars holds that Julius Caesar was the son of Caesar and destined to unite the world. Upon doing so however, the traitorous Liberatores conspired to slay Caesar before his senate and people. Despite this, Mars' People avenged their fallen imperator and sacrificed the Liberatores in the name of Mars. But over time, the Liberatores returned and plagued the empire from the shadows until it eventually fell. Without Mars and his people the world brought about the Event. Now, the Prophet Caesar seeks to bring about a militant faith bound together by the common cause of Nova Pax Romanum, a New Roman Peace. Using the teachings of Mars and Rome of Old, the Cult builds new temples to Mars, legions worthy of the Mars, and speaks the tongue of their forebears. As they expand, they assimilate the faiths of those they conquer. All becoming the domain of Mars, building for the eventual return of Caesar. They prophecy that Caesar will return to them and establish the Nova Pax Romanum

Followers of the Cult of Pompey honor one of Caesar's enemies, Gnaeus Pompeius Magnus. According to the legends of the Pompeians, millennia before the Event, there was a great city of Pompeii, ruled by the God-Emperor Gnaeus Pompeius. Envious of the power of the God-Emperor, the despicable Caesar conspired with the evil god Vulcanus and burned the Divine City, after which he defeated the God-Emperor and imprisoned him in fiery dungeons for many millennia. Followers of the Cult of Pompeius believe that in the future the God-Emperor will return and, together with his followers, will restore his Divine City.
